# `provideMergeAllToArray`

Suggests passing an array of layers to Effect.provide instead of wrapping them in Layer.mergeAll

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377161` |
| Language Service name | `provideMergeAllToArray` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/provide-merge-all-to-array` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Db extends Context.Service<Db, { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<string> }>()("Db") {}
class Logger extends Context.Service<Logger, { readonly log: (line: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }>()("Logger") {}

declare const DbLayer: Layer.Layer<Db>
declare const LoggerLayer: Layer.Layer<Logger>
declare const program: Effect.Effect<void, never, Db | Logger>

// MUST TRIGGER: Effect.provide already merges an array of layers
export const main = program.pipe(Effect.provide(Layer.mergeAll(DbLayer, LoggerLayer)))
/**
                                                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(provide-merge-all-to-array): Effect.provide accepts an array of layers and merges them itself; pass the layers as an array instead of wrapping them in Layer.mergeAll.
*/
```
